mapper.insert: insert into prj_check_plan( plan_number, contract_number, contract_start_date, prj_regular_assign, assign_status, contract_id ) values( #{planNumber}, #{contractNumber}, #{contractStartDate}, #{prjRegularAssign}, #{assignStatus}, #{contractId} )
mapper.select:
select p.CONTRACT_NUMBER, p.CONTRACT_ID, p.PLAN_ID, p.ACTUAL_FINISH_DATE, p.PRJ_REGULAR_ASSIGN, p.plan_check_date, cc.tenant_id as bp_id, ( SELECT scvb.meaning AS value_name FROM sys_code_value_b scvb, sys_code_b scb WHERE scb.CODE = 'PRJ_CHECK_REGULAR_ASSIGN' AND scb.code_id = scvb.code_id AND scvb.enabled_flag = 'Y' AND scvb.VALUE= p.PRJ_REGULAR_ASSIGN ) PRJ_REGULAR_ASSIGN_N, p.ASSIGN_STATUS, ( SELECT scvb.meaning AS value_name FROM sys_code_value_b scvb, sys_code_b scb WHERE scb.CODE = 'PRJ_ASSIGN_STATUS' AND scb.code_id = scvb.code_id AND scvb.enabled_flag = 'Y' AND scvb.VALUE= p.ASSIGN_STATUS ) ASSIGN_STATUS_N, p.EMPLOYEE_ID, p.CONTRACT_START_DATE, p.plan_number, cc.HOST_PROJECT_MANAGER, ( SELECT s.description FROM sys_user s WHERE s.user_id = cc.HOST_PROJECT_MANAGER )employee_id_n, (SELECT min(co.write_off_date) FROM con_contract t, con_contract_cashflow cf, csh_write_off co WHERE t.contract_id = cf.contract_id AND cf.cf_item = 0 and cf.times = 0 AND co.cashflow_id = cf.cashflow_id AND cf.WRITE_OFF_FLAG != 'NOT' and co.contract_id= t.contract_id and t.project_id = cc.project_id and t.CONTRACT_STATUS not in ('CANCEL','TERMINATE','ET')) first_pay_date
FROM prj_check_plan p,prj_project cc
cc.project_id=p.contract_id
and p.contract_id = #{contractId}
and trunc(p.plan_check_date) = trunc(#{planCheckDate})
order by p.plan_id desc

SELECT DISTINCT p.contract_id, pp.ref_project_id as project_id, p.prj_regular_assign, nvl( (SELECT pc.actual_finish_date FROM prj_check_plan pc, prj_project pro WHERE pc.contract_id = pro.PROJECT_ID AND pro.REF_PROJECT_ID = pp.REF_PROJECT_ID AND pc.actual_finish_date IS NOT NULL and rownum=1), SYSDATE) actual_finish_date FROM prj_check_plan p, prj_project pp WHERE p.contract_id = pp.project_id AND p.assign_status = 'achieved'
mapper.update: UPDATE prj_project pp, prj_check_plan p SET p.assign_status = 'achieved', p.actual_finish_date=#{actualFinishDate} WHERE pp.project_id = p.contract_id AND p.assign_status = 'unachieve' AND p.prj_regular_assign = #{prjRegularAssign} AND pp.ref_project_id = #{projectId} AND pp.data_class = 'VIRTUAL_CON' AND pp.data_type = 'NORMAL'

UPDATE prj_project pp, prj_check_plan p SET p.assign_status = 'achieved', p.actual_finish_date=#{actualFinishDate} WHERE pp.project_id = p.contract_id AND p.assign_status = 'unachieve' AND pp.tenantId = #{bpId} AND pp.data_class = 'VIRTUAL_CON' AND pp.data_type = 'NORMAL'
mapper.select: select max(t.plan_check_date) from (select p.plan_check_date, ( SELECT pp.tenant_id FROM prj_project pp WHERE pp.project_id = p.contract_id ) bp_id from prj_check_plan p) t where t.bp_id = #{bpId};
